title: Amazon reports Q2 ad revenue up 26% YoY to $19.81B, vs. $19.43B est., and subscription services revenue up 12% YoY to $13.73B (Annie Palmer/CNBC)
summary: Annie Palmer / CNBC: Amazon reports Q2 ad revenue up 26% YoY to $19.81B, vs. $19.43B est., and subscription services revenue up 12% YoY to $13.73B — Amazon reported better-than-expected revenue and cloud growth for the second quarter. The stock shot up more than 9% in extended trading.
